g.text: Eligibility: 4m divides r−1; F₀ has degree 2n
Upper n+1 coefficients → balanced Clenshaw → H(W), Dₙ(W)
F₀(v) = vⁿ H(v + v⁻¹) · both output polynomials have degree n
Four phases u: gcd(Dₙ − u − u⁻¹, uH − c)
Capped quadratic lift → gcd with vⁿ − u → disjoint union + zero
Scale back to Z → exact first-constraint roots → existing recovery
Unsupported or capped: original path, with all attempted work charged
